background_notes.fact: For the free rank-three Chevalley Lie algebra L_Z of D026 and its scalar extension L_K of D027, K-linear operators A,B,H satisfying [H,A]=2A, [H,B]=-2B and [A,B]=H define a Lie action by sending the three formal generators to A,B,H and extending K-linearly. A K-linear subspace is invariant under this action exactly when it is invariant under A,B,H. This holds in every characteristic.

grounds.reason: L_Z is free on the three formal generators and its bracket is alternating and Z-bilinear with the displayed generator relations.
L_K is the scalar extension with the bracket and proposed action extended K-linearly.
H005 gives the corresponding three commutators on V.
N002 gives the intertwining of the integral restrictions with x,y,h through inclusion.
N003 gives the ring homomorphism F and the K-linear isomorphism S intertwining F with ind.

background_notes.justification: The restriction relations in S001 follow pointwise through the injective inclusion. A unital ring homomorphism preserves differences, products and integer multiples, so F preserves those relations; conjugating by S preserves them for A=ind(x_M), B=ind(y_M), H=ind(h_M). The three scalar-extended formal generators span L_K. Expand both the Lie bracket and the endomorphism commutator bilinearly: their values agree on each pair of generators by the three displayed relations, their reversed relations and the zero diagonal commutators. Hence they agree on all elements. This uses no division, including in characteristic 2. For invariance, each action is a K-linear combination of A,B,H, so closure of the subspace under addition and scalar multiplication gives the forward implication; the reverse implication follows by selecting the generators.
